meta.source: NYC Taxi & Limousine Commission (TLC) Trip Record Data, yellow and green taxi trips, October 2024
meta.terms: NYC public data set (NYC Admin. Code 23-502: no registration, licence or use restrictions; source and modifications must be stated). TLC makes no representation as to accuracy.
meta.modified: Aggregated to pickup counts per taxi zone and hour of week; Newark airport, unknown and outside-NYC zones dropped; no row-level trips.

checks.name: census: all zones measured gives the truth exactly
census: interval width is zero (finite population correction)
unbiased: 300 spread placements average within 6% of the truth
reproducible: same seed gives the same placement
allocation: sums to the budget and respects the floor

failed: unbiased: 300 spread placements average within 6% of the truth
